title: Coffee for Ma Gomba

nodes.speaker: Ma Gomba
nodes.text: Looking for me, my little penny bun?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Looking for me, my little penny bun?

nodes.speaker: Ma Gomba
nodes.text: I'm surprised you want to come near me without a bio hazard suit.

nodes.text: Quite. I do hope that girl put enough nootropic fungus powder in it this time.

nodes.text: Oh I’m not going to drink this. I simply wish to check whether my mushrooms are being used as they should be.

nodes.text: I’m sure she does. It simply isn’t worth my time to learn what it is.

nodes.text: My dear, I don't care. Now if you wouldn't mind taking a sip, we can begin.

nodes.text: But of course. You've been such a useful guinea pig in the past.

nodes.text: That's what I'm hoping to find out.

nodes.text: You should pay more attention to what you eat.

nodes.text: There's my good little piggy. Tell me, how do you feel?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: There's my good little piggy. Tell me, how do you feel?

nodes.text: Ugh how tiresome. I'll just have to find another subject. Excuse me.

nodes.text: Marvelous. Another success. Run along now. And come back soon.
